name: Suzuki Burgman 400 / 650
engine: 385-400 cc single (AN400) or 638 cc twin (AN650), liquid-cooled, fuel injected or carb, automatic
intro: Suzuki's big touring scooters. The 650 has an electronically controlled automatic. Several years have recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2005 AN650s are in recall 05V497 (fuel pump retainer ring). 2008-2012 AN400s are in recall 16V018 (regulator/rectifier). 2012 AN400 and AN650 scooters are in recall 12V038 (brake light switches). 2013-2014 AN650s are in recall 15V852 (tappet and cam wear).

G: Early AN400s have a carb. Later Burgmans are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.

recalls.what: Fuel pump retainer ring may let fuel leak. Suzuki advised not to ride until fixed.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the retainer ring free.

recalls.what: Brake light switches may fail, so the brake light may not work and the scooter may not start.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the brake light switches free.

recalls.what: Regulator/rectifier circuit board can lift off its case, so the battery stops charging and the engine can stall.
